instruction:
Gerber X3 Export with Proper Attributes

You have a 4-layer KiCad PCB in /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb. The required output layer-to-filename mapping is given in /home/user/Desktop/layers.txt.

Export a complete Gerber X3 file set for the board. Each file must carry the correct TF (type-field) attributes as required by the Gerber X3 specification. Output all 12 files into /home/user/Desktop/gerbers/.

Requirements:
1. Exactly 12.gbr files, one per layer listed in /home/user/Desktop/layers.txt, using the exact filenames given there.
2. Every file must contain %TF.GenerationSoftware,KiCad,Pcbnew,9.0.0*%.
3. Every file must contain %TF.FileFunction,<function>*% with the appropriate IPC-7351 FileFunction for its layer (e.g. Copper,L1,Top for top copper; SolderMask,Top; Legend,Top; SolderPaste,Top; Profile,NP; Drillmap for drill).
4. Every file must contain %TF.Part,Single*%.
5. Every file must use %FSLAX46Y46*% and %MOMM*%.
6. Each file must end with M02* as the final data line.
7. Each file must define at least one aperture (%ADDxx...*%).

Write all files to /home/user/Desktop/gerbers/.
source: Ucamco Gerber Format Specification (revision 2024.05) (Ucamco Gerber X3 attributes), KiCad 9 Official Documentation — PCB Editor / Schematic Editor / CLI
